# Documentation Rules

- Do NOT create README.md files automatically.
- Do NOT create any documentation files unless I explicitly request them.
- Do NOT generate project summaries, architecture documents, guides, changelogs, or setup instructions.
- Do NOT create additional Markdown files to explain code changes.
- Do NOT update existing documentation unless explicitly requested.
- Focus only on implementing the requested functionality.
- Keep responses short and concise.
- Do not waste tokens explaining every file or function.
- Before creating any documentation file, ask for my permission.
